Scene Prompts.Prefix: Create one comic panel from the source panel data.
Scene Prompts.1st Panel: This is the first panel of the scene. Establish the location, cast, and action clearly.
Scene Prompts.2nd Panel: This is Panel 2. Each final panel is generated from its own bundle; continuity is carried by the blocking ledger when a plan exists.
Scene Prompts.3rd Panel: This is Panel 3. Each final panel is generated from its own bundle; continuity is carried by the blocking ledger when a plan exists.

Sketch Prompts.Prefix: Produce black-and-white rough sketch output only.
Sketch Prompts.Chunk: Render the ordered source panels as labeled sub-panels in reading order.

Character Sketch Prompts.Prefix: Create a reusable character reference sheet view.
Character Sketch Prompts.Character: Preserve identity, proportions, clothing silhouette, palette, and distinctive features.
Character Sketch Prompts.Front: Camera: orthographic front view, eye level, full body in frame, facing the camera.
Character Sketch Prompts.Three-Quarter: Camera: three-quarter view, eye level, full body in frame, turned about 45 degrees from front.
Character Sketch Prompts.Profile: Camera: strict side profile, eye level, full body in frame, facing left.

Image Prompt Variations.animation-polish: Render as clean production animation stills with stable volumes and readable silhouettes.
Image Prompt Variations.cinematic-depth: Add cinematic depth with layered foreground and background while preserving the comic contract.
